images.caption: A U.S. Air Force Douglas A-1G Skyraider (s/n 52-132528, "War Monger") of the 6th Air Commando Squadron at Pleiku Air Base, South Vietnam, circa in 1968. It later served with the 1st SOS and was then transferred to the South Vietnamese Air Force where it served with the 516th and 518th Fighter Squadrons. It was one of eleven Skyraiders to escape to Thailand in late April 1975.

images.filename: Christmas Special - Bob Hope and his star-studded cast touched down at Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam, December 19, 1966... - NARA - 542299.tif
images.caption: Scope and content:  Christmas Special -- Bob Hope and his star-studded cast touched down at Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam, December 19, 1966, enroute to Dragon Mountain, home of the 2nd Brigade, 4th Infantry Division for his first Christmas show for servicemen in Vietnam. Major General A.S. Collins, Jr. (right), commanding general, 4th Infantry Division, and Colonel William K. Bonneaux (left), 633rd Combat Support Group Commander, greeted the Hope troupe upon arrival and escorted them aboard Army helicopters which airlifted them to Dragon Mountain. About 400 Air Force personnel from Pleiku joined some 4,500 Army troops to watch the first Christmas Special show.

images.filename: Two Douglas A-1H Skyraider take off for a bombing mission in Vietnam, in February 1969 (051123-F-1234P-021).JPG
images.caption: Two Douglas A-1H Skyraider (s/n 52-134621 and 52-134628 or 52-137628) take off for a bombing mission, in February 1969. The partly visible tail code "E" would identify these aircraft as from U.S. Air Force 6th Special Operations Squadron (tail code "ET") at Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam. Note the old U.S. Navy Mark 8 300 US gallon (1136 litre) centerline tank under the nearer Skyraider.
images.alt: Two Douglas A-1H Skyraider (s/n 52-134621 and 52-134628 or 52-137628) take off for a bombing mission, in February 1969. The partly visible tail code "E" would identify these aircraft as from U.S. Air Force 6th Special Operations Squadron (tail code "ET") at Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam. images.filename: Douglas A-1J Skyraider of the 6th SOS at Pleiku Air Base, circa in 1968.jpg
images.caption:
U.S. Air Force Lt. Col Norman Repp, commander of the 6th Special Operations Squadron poses in front of one of the squadron's Douglas A-1J Skyraider (s/n 52-142021, "Su Nan Sam"), circa in 1968.
The A-1J 142021 was later transferred to the South Vietnamese Air Force and was lost on 26 December 1972.

images.filename: Douglas A-1G Skyraider of the 1st ACS prepares for take-off from Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam, in 1966.jpg
images.caption: A U.S. Air Force Douglas A-1G Skyraider (BuNo 134997) of the 1st Air Commando Squadron prepares for take-off from Pleiku Air Base, Vietnam, in 1966. This aircraft was shot down on 22 November 1966. The pilot was rescued and the aircraft was later recovered but it was subsequently scrapped at Pleiku Air Base.
